1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One fragment: changing translation, inertial response and ±22px registration; rotation and coupling are inactive.
1.natural_language: Test each horizontal drive before clamping: it may follow or reverse your hand. Compare HAND X with the destination square, then steer using the discovered direction. Track the unrotating moving aperture, clamp the fragment when its rim is green, and keep steering while the seam closes. Rotation is locked. Between deliberate steering controls the board holds; each steering control advances one fixed tactical interval.
